text: No, the method did not find any tree-cover loss event on this property after 2020. While the JRC dataset confirmed 91.77% of the asset was forest in 2020, the analysis (using Hansen GFC 2025 data, with annual coverage through 2025) did not detect any subsequent loss events meeting the 0.5-hectare minimum threshold. The full asset area remained within valid data coverage (100% fraction), but no post-2020 changes were observed or corroborated.
